Mira (AE): FYI inbound POC from GraniteCorp — they need SSO + SCIM + RBAC, plus domain controls for sub-brands. timeline: 4-week POC. Can we confirm scope?
Dan (SE): thanks. main asks: SAML SSO (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated), SCIM provisioning with delta support, role claim mapping, domain ownership validation for tenant isolation.
Lee (Sales Eng): Pricing question: if they want Dedicated for predictable latency, want monthly reserved GPUs — whats the minimum commit? also private VPC option? need rough quote.
Raj (SRE): For Dedicated min commit is 4 GPUs / month baseline. VPC/private on prem is separate licensing — point them to enterprise team. I'll ping infra pricing doc.
Claire (Security): They'll send a security questionnaire. Key Qs we need answers for: data residency, SCIM logs retention, KMS/HSM key custody, SAML cert rotation policy, SCIM rate limits and delta guarantees.
Mira (AE): They asked about SCIM deltas — do we support incremental syncs (delta tokens) and handling bulk creates w/ certain rate limits?
Dan (SE): We support SCIM 2.0 with incremental delta tokens and cursor-based sync. Rate limits: default 600 req/min for hosted customers; for Dedicated we can increase. For large initial sync recommend bulk CSV import + staged delta.
Lee (Sales Eng): Does delta mean we can avoid full re-provision every night for 50k users? that's the ask.
Dan (SE): yes, delta avoids full walk. But caveat: if they do bulk changes (50k at once) we recommend using our bulk endpoint + notify provisioning team to lift throttles during onboarding.
Mira (AE): They also want RBAC mapping — they want Okta groups -> app_roles -> Redwood roles. Any gotchas?
Dan (SE): pattern: map Okta group to "role" SCIM attribute or SAML group claim. Recommend using SCIM group membership when provisioning to keep authoritative source in IdP. Provide example mapping in SCIM patch payload.
Dan (SE): Example SCIM patch snippet:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/123
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "replace", "path": "roles", "value": ["redwood:admin"]}
  ]
}
```
Claire (Security): Also confirm SAML attributes: need email, groups, name, and optional tenant_id claim for domain-locked tenants. What's our session max TTL? They want 8 hours.
Raj (SRE): Session TTL is configurable per-tenant; default 1 hour. Dedicated/Private can set up to 12h with controls. Note long TTLs increase risk; we recommend 8h only if MFA enforced.
Mira (AE): Domain controls: customer wants to lock tenant creation to certain verified domains and prevent self-signup. How's that enforced?
Dan (SE): We do domain verification using DNS TXT + wildcard support for subdomains. We can enforce domain allowlist at auth layer, and deny new tenant creation from unverified emails. Document link: https://redwood.example/docs/domain-verification
Lee (Sales Eng): On pricing: can we give a rough number for 4-GPU Dedicated w/ 24/7 support and 1yr commit — ballpark range ok for initial scoping.
Raj (SRE): I'll draft an SOW with baseline numbers. rough: $Xk/month per GPU depending on model family. For demo pick model t4/latency profile; I'll give a number offline.
Mira (AE): They also asked about SCIM error handling: what happens if duplicate email or externalId mismatch? do we auto-merge?
Dan (SE): We don't auto-merge. SCIM conflicts return 409 with conflict reason. Recommend provisioning rule: use externalId (IdP user id) as canonical. Our logs include conflict detail and we can expose via webhook.
Claire (Security): For their security questionnaire, add these items to the answers: KMS integration supported (bring-your-own-key for Private), SCIM logs retention policy (90 days by default, longer with add-on), and we enforce SAML cert rotation at least annually.
Mira (AE): Can someone prep a short demo script + test accounts we can give to their engineers for the POC?
Dan (SE): I'll create 2 test accounts in their test tenant: idp-admin (saml), scim-service (token) and example mapping. Will post config snippets tomorrow.
Lee (Sales Eng): I'll prepare an initial commercial email with Dedicated + Private option and request a call to walk infra and legal. Want to include SRE + Security in that call.
Mira (AE): Great. Action items:
- Dan: SCIM + SAML config snippets + test accounts (due tomorrow)
- Raj: draft pricing SOW and verify GPU numbers (due EOD)
- Claire: initial security questionnaire responses (due tomorrow)
- Lee: draft commercial + schedule call (due today)

Mira (AE): Anything else? :slightly_smiling_face:
Clay (infra-bot): Reminder: please attach SOC2 doc link when sending questionnaire responses. https://redwood.example/compliance/soc2
Raj (SRE): noted, will attach.
Mira (AE): thanks all, will update GraniteCorp and loop engineers. :thumbsup:
